mechanism_of_action: Apical sodium-dependent bile acid transport (ASBT) inhibitor.
primary_endpoint: Number of subjects achieving a binary response on liver histology at Week 48.
efficacy_outcome: Binary responders: SHP626 5 mg, 4; 10 mg, 2; 20 mg, 3; placebo, 5. Statistical comparisons were not provided.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 1/49 with SHP626 5 mg, 2/49 with 10 mg, 0/49 with 20 mg, and 1/49 with placebo; no deaths.
